verdict.rationale: Token2's own fido2-manage tool documents listing and deleting resident credentials (passkeys), plus editing their metadata, and its GUI and companion apps manage passkeys. The capacity part of the story is unsupported: the evidence only says the tool shows or dumps "device information" and never mentions remaining credential slots or a capacity readout. Missing for 10: documented credential-capacity or remaining-slot reporting, a warning before the key fills up, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can list and delete the passkeys stored on my key and know its credential capacity before it fills up

citations.quote: Resident credentials (passkeys): list (with user handle), delete, edit metadata
It provides a simple interface to view device information, manage passkeys, change PINs, and perform factory resets.
fido2-manage is an open-source tool allowing to manage FIDO2.1 devices over USB or NFC, including Passkey (resident keys) management.
